text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mubarak says Netanyahu wants to start trouble over Egyptian army's Badr 96 exercises; says after attending final evaluation of exercises that Rabin was not disturbed by the 1993 exercises.
- Moussa says Israeli prime minister has gone back on Yitzhak Shamir's promises too.
- 18,000 Kintaar of cotton exported in one week.
- 160 security cameras to be installed in Egyptian museum as part of national action plan for safeguarding antiquities.
- Religious endowments minister tells clerics that any attempts to change true nature of Islam are bound to fail.
- Prime Minister Ganzouri says no exceptions will be made in war against corruption
- Sudanese allowed into Egypt without visa for appendix operation.
- President opens armed forces audio-visual centre.
- Health minister announces pay rises for nurses.
